decision_reasoning: This is not a FRESHNESS_VIOLATION (P2) -- there is no overlap with any consumed interval; the requested start (2026-09-15T00:00:00Z) is correct and untouched. It is a plain timing fact: not enough real time has elapsed since the freshness boundary opened for even one complete UTC day of fresh EURUSD decision evidence to exist yet. Admitting a partial, still-accumulating day would either (a) require inventing a new mid-day boundary convention not authorized by any existing repository precedent, risking a package whose end-boundary looks arbitrary/adaptive rather than principled, or (b) violate the mission's own 'do not use the current incomplete candle/day' instruction if today's bars are treated as closed before the day itself is over. Per the mission's own P10 guidance ('If repository conventions do not provide a pre-existing checkpoint rule: STOP and return an owner-decision requirement rather than inventing repeated optional stopping'), the same fail-closed posture is applied here to the boundary-definition question: STOP rather than invent a partial-day admission convention unilaterally.
